manchete: Messi came back, scored, cried — and the entire world stopped to watch. But who engaged the most?
insights: Messi dedicated the goal to his recently deceased father, and the internet couldn't stay quiet. Inter Miami posted the moment and engagement exploded — the club showed up with 5.2% ER on Reels, among the five most efficient of the week. Goal, grief, and tribute: the most viral combination in sports.

Cristiano Ronaldo announced that this is 'probably' his last season as a player, scored another goal for Al-Nassr and closed in on 1,000 in his career. The club responded with 40.1% ER on TikTok — fourth highest of the week. The end of an era still drives clicks like few things can.

Fenerbahçe and Lyon faced off in a playoff with Champions League qualification on the line — 23 million euros and a European spot at stake. Fenerbahçe was the club with the most appearances in the top-10 outside Brazil during the week, with 36 in total. Turkey vs France, and the internet chose the Turkish side.

Memphis Depay cut his own salary to stay at Corinthians. In a week when everyone was leaving Brazil for Europe, a European gave up money to stay in São Paulo — and Timão recorded 4.4% ER on photos, among the most efficient of the week.
contraste: Barcelona dominated every volume ranking — 70 appearances in the top-10, the most-watched reel, the most-liked photo, the TikTok with the most likes. But when it came to real connection, Flamengo closed the week with 42.9% ER on TikTok, the highest of the entire week. Billions of views on one side; on the other, a fanbase that didn't just watch — they reacted.
pra_acompanhar: Chivas appeared three times among the most efficient of the week and accumulated 42 appearances in the top-10 — more than any European club outside the Real-Barça axis. If the trend continues, Mexico could be the surprise of the month.
legenda: Messi marcou, chorou e dedicou o gol ao pai. O mundo viu. Mas o Flamengo foi quem mais engajou na semana — com 42.9% no TikTok. Alcance é o que todo mundo mede. Engajamento é o que a gente mede. 👇 Assina a newsletter e recebe os dados toda semana.
assunto: Messi dedicou o gol ao pai — mas quem engajou mais na semana?
